name: Konoha
source:
Former princess in the royal family of dragon tribe.
Since she was carefully raised as a lady from her surroundings, she has high pride.
While she has strong competitive spirit, she has a pure heart which honestly recognizes the good points of other people.
Only towards the protagonist, she shows a Tsundere temperament.

"C-Cute? Me? A-Are you an idiot!?... I-It's not that I am unhappy."
